```{r}
library(DOMformulaR)
x <- data.frame(C = 10, H = 12, O = 5, N = 0, P = 0, S = 0)
calculate_formula_metrics(x)
```

DBE is `1 + C - H/2 + N/2 + P/2`. AI_mod follows Koch and Dittmar (2006), DOI 10.1002/rcm.2386. NOSC uses formal elemental oxidation states and is linked to the framework of LaRowe and Van Cappellen (2011), DOI 10.1016/j.gca.2011.01.020. P- and S-containing formulae require cautious interpretation because formula-level indices do not specify bonding or oxidation state.
